svg.textArea: Outbound GTM system from context/docs/gtm-system.md (v1, 2026-11-13). Tools marked open are not chosen yet. No sends until legal sign-off. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Route, find people, check email and country (steps 5 to 7)
3 Send, sort replies, record and learn (steps 8 to 11)

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, messaging, playbooks

1B Buying signals
• W1 Acronis Files EOL
• W2 NTLM on mobile
• W3 EMM migration
• W4 Frontline rollout
• W5 Android Enterprise
• W6 Sovereignty
• W7 Lookalikes

1C Find companies
One row per domain, one workbook per signal
Suppress, or attach signal to existing row

1E Enrich
• AD evidence
• EMM in use
• Device and OS clues
• Second signal
• Partner region

1G Pass
On-prem AD and supported EMM known

1H Pass-provisional
Unknown, but Ready-now signal: first email confirms fit

2A Route by segment
• Trigger: highest tier wins
• Proof: police York, bank Jefferies, shift work Maersk
• Owner: direct or partner (open)
• Language: EN, DE, FR, IT

2B Find people
Up to 3: champion, influencer, economic buyer test

2E Find and verify email
Waterfall, LeadMagic, then BounceBan

2H Opt-in only
DE, AT, IT, rest of EU: no cold email, LinkedIn without pitch, partners

2I Email allowed
FR, UK, US, CA; CH pending legal

3A Sequence
• Day 1 email
• Day 2 connect, no pitch
• Day 4 email with proof
• Day 7 DM
• Day 10 email

3C Classify reply
Same business day, a person sends every reply

3E Weekly review
Learnings, personas, ICP, next week's priorities
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
